instruction: Configure a keyboard shortcut "ctrl+shift+n" to open a new VS Code window.

Complete coverage: instruction requires configuring one keyboard shortcut, evaluator checks for that specific keybinding
Practical feasibility: VSCode saves keybindings immediately to this file, no postconfig needed, file path is correct for Linux
